{{Quote|I know a great little outpost on Paqualis III, not far from the Bounty Hunters [sic] Guild…|Han Solo|<ref name="Adventures 11" />}}
'''Paqualis III''',<ref name="Adventures 11" /> also known as '''Paqualis''',<ref name="TFABG" /> was a terrestrial astronomical object<ref name="Adventures 11" /> in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]], situated along the [[Hydian Way]] and positioned at the coordinates L-8<ref name="TFABG" /> on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]].<ref name="Rebel Dossier">''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: Rebel Dossier]]''</ref> Following a skirmish with the [[bounty hunter]]s [[4-LOM]] and [[Zuckuss]], the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] offered to [[pilot]] the pair to an [[Paqualis III outpost|outpost]] on Paqualis III, near the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]].<ref name="Adventures 11" />

==Behind the scenes==
In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Paqualis III was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], released in [[2016]].<ref name="TFABG" /> In [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]], Paqualis III was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] originally created for the [[1994]] book ''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]'', by [[Rick D. Stuart]].<ref name="Galaxy Guide 10">''[[Galaxy Guide 10: Bounty Hunters]]''</ref>
